messages:
ara: Quick POC — dropping a compact self-review + manager reply pack that people can copy into their reviews. Trying to keep it <6 lines for ICs and 2–3 suggested manager lines. Thoughts? :seedling:

jess: Love the idea. Can we add a 1-line metric + 1-line impact prompt for engineers?
mike: +1, also a short canary sentence for 'stretch vs committed' would help calibration.
ara: Yep — added both. Draft below, feel free to paste or tweak.
sam: Nice. Could we include a tiny prompt for cross-functional feedback to nudge peer asks?
ara: Added that too. Also including a micro checklist managers can run during calibration.
people-ops-bot: FYI: Performance cycle reminders go out next Monday. Use these snippets to speed reviews.

ara: === SELF-REVIEW (micro, pick one per section) ===

- Role summary (1 line): "I drive [area] by [primary action], focusing on [impact]."
- Key result (metric + outcome): "Reduced median inference latency from Xms to Yms, improving conversion/throughput by Z%."
- What went well (2–3 bullets, single-line each): "Shipped model batching and cache for 95% of traffic; reduced per-token cost by 18%."
- What I’d do differently: "Start smaller canary for quantization to catch edgecase regressions earlier."
- Growth focus / ask: "Requesting 20% dedicated time for kernel-level optimization mentorship."
- Cross-functional note (1 line): "Worked with infra and product to align SLOs and rollout policy."

ara: === MANAGER SUGGESTED FEEDBACK (micro-snippets) ===

- Impact + evidence (2 lines): "Consistently improved latency for high-throughput routes; delivered a 18% cost reduction verified in staging and prod traces."
- One growth area (1 line): "Prioritize early integration tests for quantized paths to reduce regression risk."
- Calibration anchor (1 line): "Operates at Senior+ for execution, developing toward Staff by broadening cross-team influence."

ara: === STRETCH VS COMMITTED MINI PROMPT ===

- Committed: "Core SLOs met, shipped feature X, owned rollout."
- Stretch: "Led cross-org design, catalyzed new operating pattern, measurable org-level impact."

ara: === PEER REQUEST (1-line DM template) ===

- "Hey @NAME — can you provide 2 lines of feedback on how I worked with infra/product during the rollout? Examples: collaboration, clarity of requirements, and responsiveness. Thanks!"

ara: === CALIBRATION CHECKLIST (for managers, 5 quick bullets) ===

- Anchor to concrete signals: traffic, latency, cost, customer incidents.
- Ensure at least one quantitative artifact per major claim (dashboard, perf test, alert).
- Distinguish individual ownership vs team outcome.
- Confirm growth ask is actionable and time-bounded.
- Cross-check peer feedback for major discrepancies.

jess: This is great — concise and practical. Suggest one more manager line: "Clear owner for follow-up actions".
mike: Maybe a tiny example for '1-line metric' specifically for embeddings (e.g., reduced embedding p95 from 420ms to 120ms).
sam: LGTM, will paste into my direct reports' review doc. Thanks ara! :rocket:
